electricityContract.terms: Eligibility criteria apply, for terms and conditions see alintaenergy.com.au/termsandconditions or call 13 37 02.
electricityContract.variation: Alinta Energy's market tariff and feed in tariffs (where applicable) may be varied in accordance with applicable laws. If we change the applicable tariff, we will give you notice of any variations in accordance with applicable laws.

incentives.eligibility: This energy plan includes a stepped feed-in tariff. You will receive a feed-in tariff of 8c/kWh for the first 8kWh of daily exports, and 0.04c/kWh for any additional exports that day.

eligibility.information: This Energy Plan is available to eligible residential solar customers with a Qualifying Solar System. Qualifying Solar System means a solar photovoltaic generator which has a generating capacity of no more than 10kW (or larger at our discretion).

electricityContract.onExpiryDescription: This offer has no contract term.
